baseline.note: Introduce the explicit documentation review baseline for the existing application and release tooling without certifying historical behavior.

backup-recovery.migration: Previous books remain compatible at SQLite schema 17. Back up the closed database with adjacent originals and the profile before upgrade. Open a disposable copy first; the desktop profile migration retains compatibility access and refuses unsafe collisions. For rollback, preserve upgraded files and restore the complete pre-upgrade copy with the previous package; later edits are absent. DOCX expansion limits can refuse oversized inputs without changing stored books. Android retains schema 17 and the desktop archive format; update the same application with its retained signing key and preserve complete exported copies with separate keys for rollback. Newer schemas are refused before unsupported presets without changing the library. Previous books remain compatible at SQLite schema 17. backup-recovery.note: The salvage renderer only supplies the new optional publication field as absent; recovered manuscript behavior is unchanged.

maintenance.migration: Desktop identifier changes leave books, settings, and SQLite schema 17 unchanged. Windows retains its previous WebView2 profile; Android retains its package. macOS starts fresh regenerable caches and native window restore state, leaving old entries untouched. Keep the normal closed-book and profile backup before upgrade; rollback uses the previous package and preserved files. Collections retain schema 17. Older Android builds refuse this preset; keep the closed database and adjacent originals for rollback.
maintenance.note: The collection contract and CLI --story export use the shared store walk, preflight and destination writer.
